summary: Review A Batch Release Dashboard Showing All Batches Pending Final Qa
businessObject: Batch, Quality Inspection, Process Order, Batch Record, Stock Status

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access a "Batch Release" analytical Fiori app.
The dashboard lists all batches currently in Quality Inspection status with days pending and associated process order.
The user can drill down into a batch to view its complete compiled batch record and any open deviations.
The system highlights batches approaching a committed customer ship date to flag release priority.
The QA manager can record the final disposition (Release, Reject, Rework) directly from the dashboard.
The system automatically updates the batch's stock status upon disposition, making it available to Sales & Distribution where applicable.

HP.description: Access Batch Release Dashboard and view batches in QI status with days pending and process orders
Drill down into a batch with open deviations, review compiled batch record, and return to dashboard
Identify a batch approaching customer ship date (highlighted), record Release disposition, verify stock status updated to Unrestricted

AP.description: Record Reject disposition on a batch, verify stock status remains Blocked
Record Rework disposition on a batch, verify stock status remains in Quality Inspection
Drill down into a batch with no open deviations, confirm empty deviation list

NEG.description: Access dashboard when no batches are in Quality Inspection status — verify empty state message
Select a batch with no associated customer ship date — verify no priority highlight
Attempt disposition action without selecting a batch — verify validation error

ERR.description: Missing Disposition selection when attempting to record

EDGE.description: Batch with 0 days pending (just entered QI status today) — verify days pending = 0
Batch with ship date in the past (overdue) — verify highest priority highlight
Batch with ship date = today — verify immediate priority highlight
Batch with ship date far in future (30+ days) — verify no priority highlight

INT.description: Verify Released batch becomes available in SD for sales order picking
Verify Rejected batch is excluded from SD available-to-promise (ATP)
Verify process order linkage displayed correctly for batches created via production order
